Formal review of strategic alternatives announced / market speculation of potential sale

leaked_early.details: Rumors of strategic alternatives and unsolicited proposals from Concentra and Foresite/OrbiMed were reported in mid-to-late November 2023, approximately one month before the December 22 announcement.

notes: Deal followed the discontinuation of lead asset THE-630 and a pivot from reverse merger to cash-out liquidation. The final $4.05/sh was determined by a net cash adjustment mechanism, and the CVR offers 80% of proceeds from any near-term asset sales.
